name: Newton polyhedron singular along a coordinate subspace of dimension 0

intrinsic.summary: 1 blowup with smooth centres (1 along larger centres); 2 final charts.

dual_complex.convention: Exceptional divisor on the smooth strict transform in the germ over the origin over Qbar.

certificate.method: Blowups with smooth centres; certified by ideal calculations. Centre rule: maximal order
certificate.description: Every centre is smooth. In every final chart the strict transform is smooth on its part of the origin fibre by the Jacobian criterion. Properness gives the same conclusion over a neighbourhood of the origin.
certificate.atlas_verification: Strict transform on the owned origin fibre

embedded.summary: The divisor has normal crossings at the origin, with 2 components through it: the identity is an embedded resolution near the origin.

dual_complex.convention: Ambient exceptional divisor in the germ over the origin over Qbar.

certificate.method: smooth components with independent differentials at the origin
certificate.atlas_verification: Embedded normal crossings on the owned origin fibre

monodromy.method: Euler characteristics on the disjoint parts of the resolution atlas

topological.formula: sum_I chi(E_I^open intersect pi^(-1)(0)) * prod_{i in I} 1/(N_i*s + nu_i)
topological.method: Euler characteristics on the disjoint parts of the resolution atlas

pole_check.reason: Every actual pole has a local monodromy eigenvalue witness.
